algorithm: one deterministic uncapped UCB-Pandora target policy
distribution_models: conditional shifted-exponential tail after isotonic transformation
target_selection: minimum frozen development-profile geometric-mean characters among single policies whose 0.10 train-cross-fit + 0.90 development-profile accuracy reaches the unshifted requested target
fixed_n_baseline_1: minimum-character integer N reaching requested accuracy on train; same N evaluated on test
fixed_n_baseline_2: held-out oracle minimum-character integer N reaching adaptive held-out accuracy
tail_decay_definition: smooth expected-improvement multiplier (opens/minimum_opens)^(-tail_decay); no horizon or cap
